label: Depth-one certificate
title: One step of observed history is certified at every ring; the periodic census misses full-shift depth under four observations
kind: Exact certificate of refinement depth at most one at every ring size, for eight observations
summary: Whether one step of observed history makes an observation autonomous is decided at every ring by a 256-vertex pair graph per rule; no rule needed more than 33 boolean powers. Under 232, 4, 32 and 200 the depth-one sets are constant from ring 10; under 22 the sequence has period 3 but settles only at ring 28; parity gives 248 everywhere; rules 90 and 150 alternate forever with periods 4 and 6. The bet that all-ring depth one equals full-shift depth one failed under four observations: some rules have depth one on every ring yet depth at least two on the full shift.
takeaway: Closure was decided by periodic configurations; depth is not. From here on, a depth claim must say whether it is about rings or about the full shift.
